tests_added_or_updated: 68 new independent adversarial tests added in tests/test_schema_runtime_136g_independent_verification.py, against 2 new fixture schemas in tests/fixtures/schema_runtime_136g/. Covers Draft 2020-12 conformance (prefixItems, contains/minContains/maxContains, dependentRequired, $anchor, Boolean schemas), strict-parser edge cases, the two 136G-discovered-and-repaired defects (nesting-depth crash, max_issues=0 fail-open), resource limits, loader containment, registry no-network/determinism, duplicate-$id substitution, shape-validation API robustness, error-vocabulary reachability, no-authority (including a dynamic-import defeat attempt), no-execution, and filesystem non-mutation. All 68 passed. One existing 136F-era test (test_136f_... self-referential-mapping assertion, in a 136F-owned file) was NOT modified by 136G; a 136G-owned test with an updated, stricter assertion was added instead. No 136F test file was modified.
summary: Phase 136G, independent verification plus repair. Independently re-derived, reproduced, mutated, and adversarially attacked the generic Draft 2020-12 validation-engine, strict-parser, loader, registry, and shape-validation infrastructure introduced by Phase 136F, trusting none of 136F's own tests, report prose, or classifications. Wrote 68 new independent adversarial tests against fresh, 136G-authored fixture schemas, exercising Draft 2020-12 features 136F's own fixtures did not cover. Found and repaired two genuine Blocking defects within the generic schema-runtime boundary: (1) BLOCKING-136G-1/-1b -- parse_strict_json and, independently, validate_record_shape could each raise an uncaught RecursionError on deeply nested input, contradicting the parser's own documented never-raises contract; repaired with new, independently configurable DEFAULT_MAX_NESTING_DEPTH (parser) and DEFAULT_MAX_RECORD_DEPTH (shape validation, enforced via an explicitly iterative, non-recursive depth scan) limits. (2) BLOCKING-136G-2 -- validate_record_shape(..., max_issues=0) silently reported VALID for a genuinely invalid record (fail-open), because status was computed from the truncated issue tuple instead of the full validator error list; repaired. Both repairs covered by new regression tests; Fast Green re-run after both repairs: 4391 passed, identical to the 136F baseline, zero regressions. Independently rebuilt the dependency in a second, fully clean-room virtual environment (system Python 3.14.5, no lockfile), confirming future patch/minor jsonschema upgrades within <5 do not silently change the selected validator class. Independently proved no-network behavior against a wider set of transport primitives than 136F's own tests, and independently proved the no-authority AST/text-scan boundary cannot be defeated by a dynamic-import mechanism -- an item 136F's own doc explicitly flagged as untested. Disclosed several non-blocking findings and one prerequisite finding deferred to 136H (validate_record_shape's Mapping contract is documentation-only, not runtime-enforced). Full unmarked suite freshly run after both repairs: 20196 passed, 19 failed, 20215 total, 1122.39s -- all 19 failures byte-for-byte identical to 136F's own already-classified pre-existing failure set (20196 is exactly 136F's 20128 plus this phase's 68 new tests), zero new regressions. No Stage 3 schema, fixture, typed model, semantic validator, or authority resolver/state/pointer was created. No cutover request, readiness package, authorization, candidate, certification, publication attempt, conflict record, or recovery journal was created. No authority epoch changed; no CLTR authority was created; no legacy authority was demoted or retired; no production lifecycle behavior changed; no execution capability was introduced. Legacy lifecycle remains the sole production authority; CLTR remains derivative; runtime remains Observed / observe / execution unavailable. Verdict: VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS -- READY FOR COMPANION EXECUTABLE SCHEMA SHARED CORE. Recommended next phase: 136H -- Companion Executable Schema Shared Core Implementation.

validation_results.name: strict_parser_independent_attack
validation_results.result: Independently attacked empty/whitespace-only input, top-level scalars, multiple top-level values, leading zeros, negative zero, exponent forms, very large integers, UTF-8 BOM, embedded NUL, lone surrogates, malformed escapes, invalid UTF-8 continuation bytes -- all correctly classified. Discovered and repaired BLOCKING-136G-1 (uncaught RecursionError on deeply nested input).

validation_results.name: resource_limit_attack
validation_results.result: Independently attacked exact byte-limit boundary, one-byte-over, multibyte-UTF-8-near-limit (bytes vs. text call-path agreement), max_issues=0/1/1000000, registry resource-count ceiling across multiple roots. Discovered and repaired BLOCKING-136G-2 (max_issues=0 fail-open) and the resource-count portion of BLOCKING-136G-1b (deep record vs. recursive schema).

validation_results.name: loader_containment_attack
validation_results.result: Independently attacked empty path, current-directory path, repeated traversal, hard link inside root (documented trust-boundary assumption, not a defect), content replacement between discovery and load (read fresh, not cached), and an unresolved symlink-backed trusted root (CONFIRMED-136G-5, fail-closed usability quirk, non-blocking, disclosed).

validation_results.name: registry_no_network_widened_attack
validation_results.result: Independently monkeypatched socket.socket, socket.create_connection, socket.getaddrinfo (wider than 136F's own socket.socket-only coverage) plus urllib.request.urlopen; attempted https/http/file/data/ftp/custom-scheme unregistered $ref resolution -- all fail closed with zero calls to any blocked primitive.

validation_results.name: registry_determinism_attack
validation_results.result: Independently verified insertion-order independence (root_a,root_b vs root_b,root_a), hash-seed independence (PYTHONHASHSEED=0/1/42 in fresh subprocesses), byte-identical duplicate-$id rejection (prefer-rejection confirmed), and ten-repeated-call issue-ordering stability.

validation_results.name: shape_validation_api_attack
validation_results.result: Independently attacked non-mapping input (list/str/int/None/bool/float), unknown schema id, unresolved $ref, self-referential (cyclic) dict, deeply nested record against a self-referential schema (found and repaired BLOCKING-136G-1b), record mutation (deepcopy-verified zero mutation). Disclosed PREREQUISITE-136G-1 (Mapping contract is documentation-only), deferred to 136H.
